Name: Decay Control
Author: semper1dem
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Decay Control[/b][/size]
[i]Take back control over Stardew Valley's decay systems.[/i][/center]
[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Fences rotting away overnight and tilled soil reverting to dirt are charming in theory, but on a large farm they become a never-ending maintenance chore. Decay Control gives you precise, per-type control over how fast - or slow - these systems run, without removing the mechanic entirely unless that's what you want.
Every setting defaults to vanilla behavior, so you only change what bothers you.

[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Fence Decay[/b][/size]
Set an independent decay rate multiplier for each fence type. Multipliers apply on top of the vanilla tick - set one to [b]0.0[/b] for immortal fences, [b]0.5[/b] to double their lifespan, or [b]2.0[/b] to make them decay twice as fast.
[size=3][b]Soil Decay[/b][/size]
Vanilla soil decay isn't fully predictable or safely replaceable, so this mod takes a non-destructive approach: vanilla runs first, then an optional extra roll gives soil a second chance to survive. Each type of soil has its own enable toggle, so you can leave either untouched entirely.
[b]Watered Soil Retention[/b] - After the game dries out watered soil overnight, a configurable chance can re-water it before morning. Set to [b]1.0[/b] for guaranteed retention, or something lower if you want to keep a little uncertainty. Disabled by default.
[b]Tilled Soil Survival[/b] - After the game destroys bare tilled soil (no crop planted), a configurable chance restores the tile. Set to [b]1.0[/b] and bare tilled soil will never revert to dirt. Disabled by default.
[size=3][b]Farm Animal Friendship Decay[/b][/size]
Control how much friendship farm animals lose at day-end when neglected. Vanilla applies three penalties: [b]Not Fed[/b] (-20), [b]Trapped outside overnight[/b] (-20), and [b]Not pet/talked to[/b] (-5 to -10 by the formula 10 - friendship/200). Each has its own multiplier: [b]1.0[/b] = vanilla, [b]0[/b] = no decay from that cause, [b]0.5[/b] = half decay. Set all three to [b]0[/b] for no animal friendship decay.
[size=3][b]Planned for future releases[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Path Decay Control - wear rate for flooring and paths
[*]Friendship Decay Control - weekly NPC friendship point loss
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or newer
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[/list]
[b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - adds a full in-game settings page under Mod Options. Without it, configure via [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder.

[line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
A [b]config.json[/b] is created in the mod folder on first launch. All values can also be changed in-game via Generic Mod Config Menu without restarting.
[code]
{
"WoodFenceMultiplier": 1.0,
"StoneFenceMultiplier": 1.0,
"IronFenceMultiplier": 1.0,
"HardwoodFenceMultiplier": 1.0,
"EnableWateredSoilRetention": false,
"WateredSoilRetentionChance": 0.5,
"EnableTilledSoilSurvival": false,
"TilledSoilSurvivalChance": 0.5,
"AnimalNotFedDecayMultiplier": 1.0,
"AnimalTrappedOutsideDecayMultiplier": 1.0,
"AnimalNotPettedDecayMultiplier": 1.0
}
[/code]
[line]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=green]✔[/color] Stardew Valley 1.6.x
[*][color=green]✔[/color] Multiplayer safe (host settings apply)
[*][color=green]✔[/color] Safe to add or remove mid-save
[*][color=green]✔[/color] Works alongside fence retexture/reskin mods
[*][color=green]✔[/color] Stacks with Retaining Soil fertilizer
[*][color=yellow]⚠[/color] Do not use alongside other fence, soil, or animal friendship decay mods (e.g. No Fence Decay Redux, Tilled Soil Decay) - pick one
[*][color=yellow]⚠[/color] Uses Harmony for animal friendship decay; SMAPI may show a stability warning - this is normal
[/list]
[line]

Manifest.Name: Decay Control
Manifest.Description: Granular control over decay rates in Stardew Valley. Supports per-type fence decay multipliers and soil decay probability controls. Path and friendship decay planned for future releases.
